name: Ringee
shortDescription: Outbound calling, contacts, leads and call sessions — operated from chat.
longDescription: Ringee turns ChatGPT into an outbound-sales cockpit. Search and manage contacts, prospect leads with Apollo/Prospeo, reveal or import them, spin up magic-link call sessions, log call outcomes, and schedule callbacks and meetings — all rendered as rich, interactive cards. Every action runs on top of your existing Ringee account via the Ringee MCP; sensitive actions (credits, magic links) and destructive ones (delete, revoke) always require explicit confirmation.
